segments.text: Monday morning. One email marked URGENT — a connected transaction may have missed disclosure.
Mandatory disclosure window: 48 hours. Filing deadline locked.
Your team needs to assess the impact, trace the transaction, and determine whether a breach notification is required.
If it's reportable, the filing must go out before the window closes. No extensions.
Investigate. Classify. File. The clock is running.
Half your time gone. If you haven't identified the breach yet, you're in trouble.
Breach notification filed. Reference number assigned.
Well done. Correct classification. Correct severity. Correct deadline.
You investigated, deduced, and filed — all under pressure. Not everyone can do that.
The Exchange acknowledges receipt. The board will be informed. But that's someone else's problem.
You did your job. Go finish that coffee.
Disclosure window expired. Mandatory reporting deadline missed.
The 48 hours are up. The Exchange will notice. The SFC will ask questions.
Next time, work faster. Or smarter. Preferably both.
